fact: Repository is an unofficial educational resource mapping Linux knowledge to Malaysian National Occupational Skills Standard (NOSS) under the Deep State of Mind (DSOM v0.1) framework.
Agent log output must use Standard UK English with strict ASCII prefixes ([INFO], [WARN], [SUCCESS]) and strictly avoid emojis.
Raw manual archives in references/manual/ must never be deleted.
PDF ebook and technical document compilation follows Rule 11.16 using native Linux WeasyPrint via uv run --with weasyprint with pure white (#FFFFFF !important) CSS styling.
Ansible playbook generation and auditing must follow Rule 32.43 (5-tier validation ladder) and Rule 32.44 (Zen of Ansible & Red Hat CoP good practices).
Markdown documentation nodes must follow OKF v0.2 YAML frontmatter schema and include the Sovereign Dual-License Footer.
Canonical Linux distribution references for 2026 are Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Fedora 43, and AlmaLinux 10.
